vision: Bloomberg Terminal meets startup graveyard — dark, data-dense, premium intelligence dashboard

stories.title: App Shell & Layout
stories.description: Sidebar navigation + main content area + dark theme foundation. Sidebar: logo, nav items (Dashboard, Ideas DB, Failure Library, Settings). Responsive collapse to hamburger on mobile.

stories.title: Hero Leaderboard — Top 3 Ideas
stories.description: Three large cards showing this week's top-scored startup ideas. Each card: rank badge, idea title, one-line description, LaunchabilityScore (0-100) with radial progress, 6-axis mini radar chart (Market Timing, Market Size, Competition, Tech Readiness, Execution Complexity, Failure Risk), trending arrow. Cards expand on click.

stories.title: Expanded Idea Detail Panel
stories.description: When a top-3 card is clicked, expands to show: full score breakdown by dimension (6 horizontal bars), business plan summary (2-3 paragraphs), build requirements (tech stack, team, estimated cost), market heating chart (score over last 12 weeks as area chart), and Failure Graveyard panel.

stories.title: Failure Graveyard Panel
stories.description: Inside each idea detail: shows 3-5 most similar failed startups. Each entry: startup name, year, funding raised, time-to-failure, primary failure mode badge (PMF/Timing/Team/Market/Competition/Unit Economics/Regulatory), one-line cause. Animated entry with stagger.

stories.title: Idea Database Tab
stories.description: Searchable/filterable table of all startup ideas. Columns: rank, idea name, category, score, trend, source (YC/Techstars/500/Antler). Filters: category dropdown, score range slider, source multi-select. Sort by any column. Paginated (20 per page).

stories.title: Failure Pattern Library Tab
stories.description: Visual breakdown of failure patterns. Top: 7 failure category cards with count + percentage (PMF 34%, Timing 22%, etc). Below: list of failures filterable by category. Each entry: name, year, category badge, funding, one-line summary. Click expands to full post-mortem.

stories.title: Radar Chart Component
stories.description: Reusable 6-axis radar/spider chart for the LaunchabilityScore breakdown. Axes: Market Timing, Market Size, Competition, Tech Readiness, Execution Complexity, Failure Risk. Animated fill on mount. Uses Recharts RadarChart with dynamic import + ssr:false.

stories.title: Market Heating Area Chart
stories.description: Area chart showing score trend over 12 weeks. Gradient fill, tooltip on hover, reference line for current week. Uses Recharts AreaChart with dynamic import + ssr:false. Explicit parent height h-[250px].

stories.title: Stats Strip & KPIs
stories.description: Horizontal strip below hero showing: Total Ideas Tracked (number), Active Failures Analyzed (number), Average Score This Week (number + trend), Top Category (name). Animated count-up on mount.

stories.title: Mock Data Layer
stories.description: Comprehensive mock data file with: 20 startup ideas with full scores and descriptions, 30 failed startups with post-mortems and failure categories, 12 weeks of historical scores, category distributions. Realistic data based on actual YC/startup ecosystem.

stories.title: Animations & Polish
stories.description: Framer Motion throughout: page transitions, card hover states (subtle lift + glow), stagger animations on lists, smooth expand/collapse on detail panels. Loading skeletons for all data sections. Glass morphism on cards.

stories.title: Responsive + Final QA
stories.description: Mobile responsive at 320px, 768px, 1024px, 1440px. Sidebar collapses. Cards stack vertically on mobile. Tables become scrollable. Lighthouse >90. No console errors. Bundle check with Knip.
